scopedSiteDossiers.overview: American Medical Association (AMA Insurance) physician site with Term Life (101-a/101-b QuickDecision, 10/15/20-yr Level Term 102/103/121), AD&D family plan (999), Step/Level Group Disability (601/603, G-30639-0 step and G-30641-0 level), Office Overhead (GrpOffOvr) and Hospital Indemnity family plan (303). patternInventory.title: Hide fields, cards and sections per page
patternInventory.description: Sites call .hide() on framework-rendered elements on nearly every page: txtEstimatedCost on Coverage Selection (29 sites), #beneficiary-card, #payment-card, #underwriting-steps-link on Thank You, physician details, marital-status state-law labels, member-info blue boxes, etc. A declarative per-page hidden-fields list removes most of these handlers and lets React skip rendering instead of hiding after mount.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Hide fields, cards and sections per page]

patternInventory.title: Copy, label and title overrides injected via DOM or schema mutation
patternInventory.description: Sites rewrite text by mutating data.schema.*.title in *ControllerFetch hooks or by .html()/.text() replacement after render: header contact button text, product/applicant headers, family-plan headers, payment authorization text naming the sponsor, thank-you and signature copy, field titles and validator messages. All of this is content and should live in a per-site content map keyed by page + field, alongside the existing locale.* object.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Copy, label and title overrides injected via DOM or schema mutation]

patternInventory.title: Framework method overrides via classObject.prototype
patternInventory.description: 92 sites use _.extend(mapped.view.classObject.prototype, {...}) in *ControllerComponentsReady to replace framework methods wholesale. The most-overridden are applicantInfo.togglePaymentSection / triggerPaymentMethodSelection / onSelectPaymentFrequency / selectFrequencyAll (25-30 sites), eligibility.onMemberSelect (23), coverageSelection.IsInforceSelfCoverage (23), checkSelectedPlan (21) and _isValid (20). Each copy forks framework code, so fixes never propagate. Most of these copies exist only to change one or two conditions, which is exactly what the patterns on this page turn into config.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Framework method overrides via classObject.prototype]

patternInventory.title: Launch screen section toggles (hero, Get Quote, quote category)
patternInventory.description: Almost every site hides the NYL hero block in launchScreenViewRender, and many also hide #get-quote, the quote-category radio, landing coverage/quote sections, or toggle quote gender per category. These are pure presentation switches executed after render, which causes a visible flash and is invisible to anyone reading the config.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Launch screen section toggles (hero, Get Quote, quote category)]

patternInventory.title: Header and footer branding (TPA name, phone ribbon, links, fax, form numbers)
patternInventory.description: headerViewRender and footerViewRender/footerViewBeforeRender are used to rename the contact button, inject a phone/help ribbon, add rate-PDF or extra nav links, override siteData.tpa.fullName, blank the association name, and append fax, copyright, policy form numbers or group numbers to the footer. siteDetails and locale.header already cover part of this. Extending them removes ~120 small handlers.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Header and footer branding (TPA name, phone ribbon, links, fax, form numbers)]

patternInventory.title: Eligibility field dependencies patched at fetch time
patternInventory.description: eligibilityControllerFetch rewrites data.dependentFields so a field shows when ANY of several category checkboxes is checked (txtEligWeeklyHrsSlf for DI or OO, rdJetSmokerQuestSlf for LI or DI), removes dependencies so a field is always visible, or adds new show/hide rules. Value callbacks often reorder DOM nodes with insertBefore as a side effect. A declarative visibility-rules schema with any/all conditions covers nearly all of it.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Eligibility field dependencies patched at fetch time]

patternInventory.title: Payment method/frequency restrictions per product or applicant status
patternInventory.description: Beyond the static paymentFrequency config, sites force and lock frequency (Monthly for the WAEPA family, Semiannually for avmastudent, Quarterly for waepaupgrade), remove frequencies per product (Annually off 5-yr LI for nysba/nysbagi, 10/20-yr for oma), remove a payment method per product (aap, crbg), or derive method and frequency from employment status (apwu, apwuadd, apwudigi, csfewbc, npmhu: Active/PSE get payroll Biweekly; Retired/Associate get Bill Me Quarterly). Most override _setPaymentFrequencyOptions or poke selectize directly.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Payment method/frequency restrictions per product or applicant status]

patternInventory.title: Eligibility knockouts and non-member gating
patternInventory.description: Sites override eligibility.onMemberSelect or listen to eligibility answers to disable #next and open #modal-not-member or an ineligible modal: non-members, not full-time, not working 90 days, already insured, or spouse also a member. Several WAEPA/GI sites do the opposite and override the method to remove the framework non-member block. A knockout-rules list with a message/modal id replaces all of these overrides.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Eligibility knockouts and non-member gating]

patternInventory.title: Payment method/frequency sync across product widgets
patternInventory.description: About 29 sites copy-paste the same ~150-line override of togglePaymentSection / triggerPaymentMethodSelection / onSelectPaymentFrequency so that picking a method or frequency for one product applies it to all, and clears bank fields when switching away from Bank Account. The framework already has selectMethodAll / selectFrequencyAll flags, but only avmalifegi uses them. This is the single biggest copy-paste block in the codebase.

patternInventory.description: Sites pre-check categories when self is selected, default the eligibility state (calbar to California, opit), preselect the only product (lsba-gi), default DI waiting period to 90 Days (aafp, acp), default empty payment widgets to Bill Me + Semiannually (avmalifegi, avmalifetrust), or prefill from the membership form. getDefaultCovgPageValues covers coverage amounts but nothing else.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Pre-selection and default values (categories, state, amounts, waiting period)]

patternInventory.title: Custom validators and validation messages
patternInventory.description: Sites patch validators arrays at fetch or render time: membership ID exact length/numeric (ruaa, aao, aaop), required ZIP, agent code length (csea, cseagi), employment date within 365 days (waepanewhire, waepaupgrade), numeric ranges (crnastudent), letters-only names and card expiry on the HPCI form (lifehelp, lifehelpgi), and custom required messages. These belong in a per-field validation schema (e.g. zod/yup) referenced from config.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Custom validators and validation messages]

patternInventory.title: Dependent coverage requires self (in-force popups, cascading uncheck)
patternInventory.description: 23 sites override coverageSelection.IsInforceSelfCoverage to change when the "dependent without self" popup appears, and others wire listeners so checking a dependent auto-checks self, unchecking self clears dependents, spouse CAP requires self CAP, BPP requires member LTD, or child LI requires self/spouse on the same product. This is relational validation that fits a dependency graph.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Dependent coverage requires self (in-force popups, cascading uncheck)]

patternInventory.title: Payment section visibility (forced on/off, optional via URL, members skip)
patternInventory.description: Sites force rdAddPaymentInfo to Yes and hide the question (payment mandatory), hide #payment-card entirely for no-cost/GI sites, set it to No for current members (waepa, waepawl, gebafifty), or make payment optional when ?pmt=opt is present (apwu, apwuadd, ieeewl, npmhu, waepawl). isPaymentRequired/isPaymentMandatory cover only the static case.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Payment section visibility (forced on/off, optional via URL, members skip)]

patternInventory.title: Auto-answer and hide questions (contact preference, beneficiary, add-payment)
patternInventory.description: Sites programmatically click or set a radio and then hide it: contact preference forced to Residential (22 sites), add-beneficiary forced Yes/No or the beneficiary card hidden (GI and rider-only flows), and the add-payment question. A field preset with hidden:true is cleaner and keeps the submitted value explicit.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Auto-answer and hide questions (contact preference, beneficiary, add-payment)]

patternInventory.title: Rate display placeholders and rate-error handling
patternInventory.description: Sites override onRatesError / _successFetchingRates to show "Not Available", a blank, or "See coverage details" per product, suppress rates for complimentary/no-cost products, show "contact administrator" for family-plan dependents (nysscpa), or inject hardcoded flat premiums (aiit CAP, usba CAP). productsWithNoRates, unavailableRates and fieldsWithNoRates already exist and could absorb most of this.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Rate display placeholders and rate-error handling]

patternInventory.title: AD&D family plan display (labels, headers, "See coverage details")
patternInventory.description: Sites with family-plan AD&D (covgAccdntDeathFP, 999) or travel products inject "Percentage of member benefit" under the benefit label, rewrite the applicant header to "Family Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance Coverage", replace the rate box with "See coverage details" when no self coverage exists, and relabel spouse/child checkboxes. The same block is copy-pasted almost verbatim across hpso, nso, calsea, calsearet and others. isAdndFamilyPlan / adndFamilyPlanProdCode already exist and can drive this.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=AD&D family plan display (labels, headers, "See coverage details")]

patternInventory.title: Product mutual exclusion (one product / product family per application)
patternInventory.description: Sites disable other products when one is checked: 5/10/20-yr LI exclusive (calbar), LI 10-yr vs Group DI (aaop), DI Long vs DI Long Plus (abe), one family across 101/102/153/999 (afa), AD&D/Travel disables everything (calsea). Many hand-write disableExceptFiveYr/TenYr/TwentyYr overrides. The framework already supports locale.coverageSelectionScreen.mutualExclusionSelection with sub-array groups, but only 7 sites use it.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Product mutual exclusion (one product / product family per application)]

patternInventory.title: Locked or derived benefit amounts
patternInventory.description: Sites set and disable amount selectize controls: fixed child amounts ($5,000 in hpso, nso), dependent amount mirrors the member amount (acs, acsqd, asme HI), AD&D rider equals base (roa, aap), spouse <= 50% of member (waepa), child derived from member/spouse (waepa, waepawl), percent-of-self (ama), salary multiple with cap (nada-employee), and amount from an eligibility input (crnastudent). Static cases are config; formulas need a small expression or hook.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Locked or derived benefit amounts]

patternInventory.title: JET-specific e-signature consent text
patternInventory.description: 22 sites carry an identical signatureControllerFetch that, when app.getIsJet() is true, replaces the chkSignConsentSlf/Sps title with the same JET consent sentence. This should simply be the framework default text when JET is active.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=JET-specific e-signature consent text]

patternInventory.title: URL-parameter driven behavior
patternInventory.description: app.getQueryParams() drives: prefilled amounts by G-number (calbar ?amt=G-123_250000), campaign banners (calbar), preselected categories (ama, isitrust, nysba), applicant type (acsinitiategi ?applicant=spouse), optional payment (?pmt=opt), rider-only add flows (waepa/waepawl ?app=cir|abi), monthly-rate display (ama ?mrate), and ZEIS prefill (?w=). A single URL-param mapping in config makes these discoverable and testable.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=URL-parameter driven behavior]

patternInventory.title: US/Canada address switching (postal code, provinces)
patternInventory.description: 22 sites push dependentFields in eligibilityControllerFetch so that choosing a Canadian province swaps txtZipCodeSlf for txtCanadianZipCodeSlf, and they add a required validator to both. The code is near-identical across sites. oma goes further with a full Canadian locale (provinces, postal code, dd/mm/yyyy).
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=US/Canada address switching (postal code, provinces)]

patternInventory.title: Conditional rider visibility and rider cleanup
patternInventory.description: Riders are shown or hidden based on the base amount (CAT rider >= 3000 in ama/amasi; CIR rider by amount range in waepa/waepawl), the waiting period (aiche catastrophic rider only for 90/180 days), or the benefit duration (acp, asme, geocare, spe via onChangeOfBenefitDuration). COLA applies only to career coverage (ieee). Several sites also uncheck riders when the base coverage is unchecked (aap, roa).
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Conditional rider visibility and rider cleanup]

patternInventory.title: Benefit amount limits: aggregate maximums (DI + FPO, income-based)
patternInventory.description: Sites override coverageSelection._isValid / checkDIMaxAggrValidation / checkMaxAgregationLimitForSlf to enforce DI monthly benefit + FPO rider <= policy max (acs, acsqd, acp, ieee, isitrust), income-percentage caps (abe, asce, ruaa, txcpa), $6,000 LTD + FPO caps (aiit, avmalifetrust), or aggregate life max per member status (nysba). The logic is near-identical arithmetic with different numbers.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Benefit amount limits: aggregate maximums (DI + FPO, income-based)]

patternInventory.title: Category / product availability by eligibility answers
patternInventory.description: Eligibility answers such as member status (nysba, aap), employment status (apwu, npmhu: Retired hides DI), applicant type (amagi Student/Spouse), attestation (nspe hides DI), selected association (isitrust, isiexpress) or marital status (crbg) decide which categories or products are offered. Today this is done by hiding checkboxes or rewriting schema.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Category / product availability by eligibility answers]

patternInventory.title: Benefit amount / option list manipulation
patternInventory.description: *ControllerFetch hooks rewrite schema options: amounts by age band and waiting period (geba, gebafifty), options from ranges (usba), append static options (csea), remove the $0 option (geba), sort descending (aafp, lifehelpgi), rename option labels/values (apta, geocare, opit, spe), and restrict waiting period by age (nysscpa). locale.coverageSelectionScreen.amountsOrder already exists for sorting (used by 3 sites).
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Benefit amount / option list manipulation]

patternInventory.title: Underwriting rules: medical-question skips and SI/QD badges by age and amount
patternInventory.description: navigation[].skipIf functions skip medical-question pages when age/amount fall within non-medical limits (ncsfa, roa, csfewbc, auic) or by G-number (isitrust, atpe). Coverage Selection shows Simplified Issue/QD badges using the same age×amount bands (apwu, npmhu, waepawl, csfewbc). These bands are business rules that should be data, ideally from the rule-config service.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Underwriting rules: medical-question skips and SI/QD badges by age and amount]

patternInventory.title: Multi-association sites (association picker drives acronym, logo, products)
patternInventory.description: Shared sites (isitrust, isiexpress, isitrustgi, tie, opit, geocare, lifering, map, cat, catgi, caa, oma) ask the applicant to pick an association, then rewrite associationAccronym in eligibilityBeforeSubmit, swap the header logo, change labels, and restrict categories or no-rate products per association. A sub-association table in config replaces several hundred lines.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Multi-association sites (association picker drives acronym, logo, products)]

patternInventory.title: Field reordering via insertBefore/insertAfter
patternInventory.description: Sites move rendered fields with jQuery, e.g. weekly hours after email (acs, acsqd), DI income vs weekly hours ordering (aad, aia, apta), or the full-time-student question into the DI container (nysba). In React this is just an order array per page.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Field reordering via insertBefore/insertAfter]

patternInventory.title: Bill Me informational modal
patternInventory.description: aia, hpso, nso, waepa and waepawl open #modal-bill-me when Bill Me is selected, from inside their copied payment-sync override. apha and roa use the framework showBillingFeeModal flag instead. Consolidate on the flag.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=Bill Me informational modal]

patternInventory.title: ZEIS prefill by simulated clicks
patternInventory.description: When ?w= is present and zeisMap.zeisData is loaded, abe, apsit, chemists, hpso and nso prefill Eligibility and Coverage Selection by triggering clicks and setting selectize values in sequence. zeisMap.zeisPrefillControls exists but is commented out on most sites. In React, prefill should write directly into form state.
patternInventory.sourceLocator: data.patterns.patterns[title=ZEIS prefill by simulated clicks]
